pt_BR.first_run.notice:
O AT foi aberto na pasta {folder}.

Como não existe um arquivo App/settings.json aqui, entende-se que é uma nova Pasta de Trabalho.

Confirma que o AT utilize essa pasta? Recomenda-se a utilização de uma pasta vazia, em qualquer local do seu computador. Cancele e mova o arquivo para outra pasta, se não concordar.
pt_BR.first_run.no_tty: Não há um terminal onde perguntar, então nada foi criado. Rode o AT interativamente para confirmar a Pasta de Trabalho.
pt_BR.first_run.cancelled: Nada foi criado. Mova o AT para outra pasta, se não era esta.
pt_BR.first_run.admin_needed: A pasta ainda não tem administrador, e sem ator nenhum o AT não expõe. Crie o primeiro com `at-cli admin`.
pt_BR.migration.declarations.written: As declarações desta versão chegaram à pasta: {names}.
pt_BR.migration.declarations.kept: A pasta já tinha todas as declarações desta versão — nada a escrever.
pt_BR.migration.declarations.extended: As declarações da pasta ganharam o que as versões anteriores mudaram sem migração: {names}.
pt_BR.migration.declarations.collision: Nestes lugares a pasta já tinha outra coisa, e a sua edição venceu: {names}. Nada foi sobrescrito — o AT avisa em vez de escolher por você.
pt_BR.migration.declarations.missing: A pasta não tem estas declarações, e o AT não as recria: {names}.
pt_BR.migration.declarations.unreadable: Estas declarações existem e não se deixam ler, e o AT não as toca: {names}. Conserte o arquivo, se quiser que a pasta ande.
pt_BR.migration.declarations.unchanged: As declarações da pasta já tinham tudo o que esta versão acrescenta — nada a escrever.
pt_BR.migration.backlog.filled: Os projetos que já existiam ganharam a prioridade que a declaração dá por padrão: {names}.
pt_BR.migration.catalogue.granted: O papel {role} ganhou o que o catálogo ganhou nesta versão: {names}.
pt_BR.migration.catalogue.kept: O papel {role} já carregava tudo o que o catálogo ganhou nesta versão — nada a escrever.
pt_BR.migration.strongbox.renamed: O código renomeou a permissão do Cofre: {names} ganhou `strongbox:read` no lugar de `cofre:read`.

pt_BR.migration.legacy.kept: A pasta da instância não tinha a grafia antiga .bill/ — nada a mover.

pt_BR.migration.capital.kept: A pasta da instância não tinha a grafia app/ — nada a mover.
pt_BR.migration.capital.same: A pasta da instância já responde a App/: este sistema de arquivos não distingue maiúsculas de minúsculas, e não há o que mover.
pt_BR.migration.capital.moved: A pasta da instância passou de app/ para App/.

pt_BR.migration.folders.no_tty: Não há um terminal onde perguntar, então as pastas ficaram com o nome que tinham.
pt_BR.migration.folders.moved: As pastas passaram a falar o idioma da tela: {names}.
pt_BR.migration.folders.declined: As pastas ficaram com o nome que tinham: {names}. O custo é esse: elas falam um idioma e a tela fala outro. O AT lê as duas grafias, mas quem abrir a pasta vai ler um nome que não é o seu.
pt_BR.migration.folders.collision: Há duas pastas para o mesmo nome interno ({names}): escolher uma seria esconder a outra. Nada foi movido — junte as duas à mão, se era isso.

en_US.first_run.notice:
AT was opened in the folder {folder}.

There is no App/settings.json here, so this is taken to be a new Working Folder.

Do you confirm that AT should use this folder? An empty folder, anywhere on your computer, is recommended. Cancel and move the file elsewhere if you disagree.
en_US.first_run.no_tty: There is no terminal to ask in, so nothing was created. Run AT interactively to confirm the Working Folder.
en_US.first_run.cancelled: Nothing was created. Move the binary elsewhere if this was not the one.
en_US.first_run.admin_needed: The folder has no administrator yet, and with no actor at all AT does not expose. Create the first one with `at-cli admin`.
en_US.migration.declarations.written: The declarations of this release reached the folder: {names}.
en_US.migration.declarations.kept: The folder already carried every declaration of this release — nothing to write.
en_US.migration.declarations.extended: The folder's declarations gained what earlier releases changed without a migration: {names}.
en_US.migration.declarations.collision: In these places the folder already carried something else, and your edit won: {names}. Nothing was overwritten — AT warns instead of choosing for you.
en_US.migration.declarations.missing: The folder does not carry these declarations, and AT does not recreate them: {names}.
en_US.migration.declarations.unreadable: These declarations are there and do not parse, and AT does not touch them: {names}. Fix the file if you want the folder to move on.
en_US.migration.declarations.unchanged: The folder's declarations already carried everything this release adds — nothing to write.
en_US.migration.backlog.filled: The projects that already existed gained the priority the declaration gives by default: {names}.
en_US.migration.catalogue.granted: The role {role} gained what the catalogue gained in this release: {names}.
en_US.migration.catalogue.kept: The role {role} already carried everything the catalogue gained in this release — nothing to write.
en_US.migration.strongbox.renamed: The code renamed the Vault's permission: {names} gained `strongbox:read` in place of `cofre:read`.
en_US.migration.reminder.renamed: The reminder's `note` field is now `remark` — the word "nota" names the Notes table now: {names}.
en_US.migration.legacy.kept: The instance folder did not carry the old spelling .bill/ — nothing to move.
en_US.migration.legacy.moved: The instance folder was .bill/ and is now app/.
en_US.migration.legacy.collision: Both .bill/ and app/ exist in this folder: two folders for one instance, and picking one would silently adopt the other. Nothing was moved — join them by hand if that is what you meant.
en_US.migration.capital.kept: The instance folder did not carry the spelling app/ — nothing to move.
en_US.migration.capital.same: The instance folder already answers to App/: this filesystem does not tell upper from lower case, and there is nothing to move.
en_US.migration.capital.moved: The instance folder went from app/ to App/.
en_US.migration.capital.collision: Both app/ and App/ exist in this folder: two folders for one instance, and picking one would silently adopt the other. Nothing was moved — join them by hand if that is what you meant.
en_US.migration.folders.no_tty: There is no terminal to ask in, so the folders kept the name they had.
en_US.migration.folders.moved: The folders now speak the language of the screen: {names}.
en_US.migration.folders.declined: The folders kept the name they had: {names}. That is the cost: they speak one language and the screen speaks another. AT reads both spellings, but whoever opens the folder reads a name that is not theirs.
en_US.migration.folders.collision: There are two folders for the same internal name ({names}): picking one would hide the other. Nothing was moved — join them by hand if that is what you meant.
en_US.migration.prose.kept: The folder did not carry the retired spelling — nothing to move.
en_US.migration.prose.collision: Both `Files/` and `Library/` exist in this folder: picking one would hide the other. Nothing was moved — join them by hand if that is what you meant.
en_US.migration.shared.kept: The folder did not carry the retired spelling — nothing to move.
en_US.migration.shared.collision: There are two folders for the same internal name ({names}): picking one would hide the other. Nothing was moved — join them by hand if that is what you meant.
en_US.migration.note.written: AT wrote `AGENT.md` at the folder root: it is the note that presents the folder to whoever starts working in it.
en_US.migration.note.kept: The folder already carried an `AGENT.md` — the one that was there stayed, and nothing was overwritten.
en_US.migration.agent_note.removed: AT removed `AGENT.md` from the root: the folder now presents itself in `README.md`.
en_US.migration.agent_note.absent: There was no `AGENT.md` at the root — nothing to remove.
en_US.migration.services.moved: The services moved into their own house, under App/services/: {names}.
en_US.migration.services.collision: The destination already carried something by this name, and what was there stayed: {names}. Nothing was overwritten — AT warns instead of choosing for you.
en_US.migration.services.kept: No service was loose in the root of App/ — nothing to move.
